q1.a: Yes. The Starter plan includes 1 property. The Pro plan covers up to 5 — each with its own offerings, branding, QR code, and analytics.

q2.q: Can I update what I'm offering?
q2.a: Anytime. Edit what you offer, prices, photos, or stock levels from your dashboard. Changes go live instantly for your guests.

q3.a: Guest payments go directly to your Stripe account. EasyHost never touches the money. We only charge your monthly subscription.

q4.q: Is it difficult to set up?
q4.a: Most hosts are live within an hour. Add what you offer, generate your QR code, print it. That's it.

q5.a: Yes. Your offerings auto-translate into English, Albanian, Italian, and German. Guests pick their language with a flag.

q6.a: Zero transaction fees on guest orders. If you ever have an issue, our team replies within a business day.

trial.a: Yes. 7 days, no credit card required. Use everything, then decide.

payments.a: You do. Payments go directly from your guest to your Stripe account via Apple Pay, Google Pay, or card. EasyHost never touches the money — we only charge your monthly subscription.

moreProperties.q: What if I have multiple properties?
moreProperties.a: The Starter plan covers 1 property at €15/month. The Pro plan covers up to 5 properties at €29/month — each with its own offerings, branding, and QR code.

cancel.a: Yes. Cancel from your dashboard in one click. You keep access until the end of the billing period.
